'''Perrichion''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] analyst who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Residing on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], she also provided the knowledge of investigation to others.
